title: 第一卷 第2章 要债的来了
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
张春妮吓得磕磕绊绊的说道：“对，对不起，我不是故意磨蹭的……”

    李华说道：“我知道，所以我来帮你了。”

    说完，转过身去，半蹲下来，然后双手抓住张春妮的小腿。

    张春妮“呀”了一声，吓得僵在原地。

    李华用力往上一提，直接把人给扔到了背上，张春妮剧烈挣扎：“你干嘛？放开我！快把我放下来！”

    “让你走过去，到地方天都要黑了。”李华动起来：“抓住我。”

    张春妮的上半身往后一顿，吓得她连忙趴下来，双手也搂住了李华的脖子。

    “轻点搂我脖子，快喘不过来气了。”李华扭头，看到张春妮趴在他背上，满脸通红，大大的眼睛也是水润水润的，好看极了。

    两人靠得很近，呼吸撞在一起，李华感觉张春妮的气息都是甜的。

    忍住直接A上去的冲动，说道：“我这也是没有办法的办法，你理解一下。”

    “我走的快，到那边就把你给放下来。”

    赵春妮赶紧松开了手，把双手撑在李华的背上，让上半身尽可能的远离李华。

    可李华走得快，抬腿的时候，身子不由自主地左摇右晃。

    两人的身子偶尔会撞在一起，虽然撞的不疼但这样的接触，让她羞耻不已。

    她不知道李华是不是故意的，也不敢吭声质疑。

    李华还真不是故意的。

    快涨潮了，他现在满脑子都是在潮水涨上来之前带着张春妮挖些海鲜出来。

    当然，偶尔的接触，他也是不由得内心颤动。

    没想到张春妮又瘦又高，身材还挺顶的。

    走了十来分钟。

    到达目标地点。

    放眼望去，除了淤泥还是淤泥，没有半点海货的影子。

    也没有人。

    这都要涨潮，赶海的人老早撤了。

    李华放下张春妮，把双手交叉，活动了下手指头，他一心要混社会，没事就打沙袋练拳头，手指都有老茧。

    这双手很适合挖洞。

    张春妮看着李华徒手挖淤泥，目光越发茫然。

    这能挖出来海货？

    当看到李华从挖出来的淤泥里找出一个大蛏子，她不由得瞪大了眼睛。

    蛏子不小，有个十来公分，拇指粗细，肥美的很。

    李华满意的点点头，随手扔进水桶里。

    继续。

    找洞眼。

    挖。

    抠。

    咔咔几下，又挖出一个蛏子。

    张春妮看的目瞪口呆。

    这也行？

    李华回头：“想学？”

    张春妮点点头。
content_en:
Zhang Chunni was so frightened that she stumbled and said, "Yes, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to be slow..."

    Li Hua said: "I know, so I'm here to help you."

    After saying that, he turned around, squatted down, and grabbed Zhang Chunni's calf with both hands.

    Zhang Chuni said "Yeah" and froze in place with fright.

    Li Hua lifted up hard and threw the person directly onto his back. Zhang Chunni struggled violently: "What are you doing? Let me go! Put me down quickly!"

    "Let you walk over there. It will be dark when you get there." Li Hua started to move: "Catch me."

    Zhang Chunni's upper body fell back. She was so frightened that she quickly lay down and put her hands around Li Hua's neck.

    "Hold my neck gently, I can't breathe anymore." Li Hua turned his head and saw Zhang Chunni lying on his back, her face flushed, her big eyes moist and moist, she was very beautiful.

    The two were so close that their breaths collided. Li Hua felt that Zhang Chunni's breath was sweet.

    Resisting the urge to go straight up, he said, "I have no other choice. Please understand."

    "I'll walk fast and I'll put you down when I get there."

    Zhao Chuni quickly let go of her hand, put her hands on Li Hua's back, and kept her upper body as far away from Li Hua as possible.

    But Li Hua walked fast, and when he raised his legs, his body swayed involuntarily.

    Their bodies would occasionally bump into each other. Although the collision didn't hurt, such contact made her extremely ashamed.

    She didn't know if Li Hua did it on purpose, and she didn't dare to question it.

    Li Hua really didn't mean it.

    The tide was coming in, and all he could think about now was taking Zhang Chuni to dig out some seafood before the tide came up.

    Of course, he couldn't help but feel his heart tremble during the occasional contact.

    Unexpectedly, Zhang Chunni was thin and tall, with a pretty good figure.

    Walked for about ten minutes.

    Arrive at the destination.

    Looking around, there is nothing but mud and mud, and there is no trace of seafood.

    No one either.

    The tide is about to rise, and the people rushing to sea have long since withdrawn.

    Li Hua put down Zhang Chunni, crossed his hands, and flexed his fingers. He wanted to be a part of society, so he punched sandbags and practiced fisting when he had nothing to do. His fingers were calloused.

    These hands are perfect for digging holes.

    Zhang Chunni looked at Li Hua digging mud with his bare hands, her eyes becoming more and more confused.

    Can we dig out seafood?

    When she saw Li Hua finding a big razor clam from the dug mud, her eyes widened.

    The razor clam is not small, about ten centimeters, about the thickness of a thumb, and very plump.

    Li Hua nodded with satisfaction and threw it into the bucket.

    continue.

    Find holes.

    dig.

    Pick.

    After a few clicks, another razor clam was dug out.

    Zhang Chunni was dumbfounded.

    Is this okay?

    Li Hua turned around: "Want to learn?"

    Zhang Chunni nodded.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 2 The debtor is coming
